Letter of Recommendation
Letter of Recommendation
Our ref: 78
2026-03-31
This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work “Residential Quarters — Delhi
Pkg-88” (INR 20.05 Cr), completed on 2023-10-25. On the basis of that engagement we record the following:
Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site;
Responsiveness of the contractor's site management.
The contractor's planning, quality control and coordination with this office were of a good standard, and the
work was commissioned without outstanding defects.
